### The Biblical Purpose for Holy Greetings - The Crosswalk Devotional - May 16
Author: Laura Bailey
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/the-biblical-purpose-for-holy-greetings-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Jude 1:2
Points:
- Early church letters opened with intentional greetings designed to strengthen and encourage the recipients.
- Jude prayed for mercy, peace, and love to abound as believers faced spiritual conflict and deceptive teachers.
- Biblical mercy offers unearned compassion and pardon because of what Jesus accomplished on the cross.
- Biblical peace remains steady despite difficult circumstances, while biblical love values others unconditionally.
- Christians today should communicate intentionally by sending thoughtful, faith-filled greetings to uplift others.

### Called, Beloved, and Kept
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/called-beloved-and-kept/
Passage: Jude 1:1-2
Points:
- Jude moved from merely knowing Jesus as a relative to worshiping Him as his Lord and Savior.
- God's sovereign call awakens believers from spiritual death into Christ's gift of life and righteousness.
- Resting in the identity of being God's beloved frees believers from past condemnation and harmful labels.
- The eternal security of being kept by and for Christ motivates believers to abandon self-absorption and serve others.
